note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. "Has been returned unopposed". Described in the nominations as: W. J. Allen, J.P. (direct labour). W. J. Allen: no party label printed in 1908. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors"); Kernan, 28 May 1914, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests"); nominations in the Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council")).
